narrative.text: Slide deck (43 pages, CC-BY-SA-3.0) by Alfred Strauch and Steven Carbno (Smart Talk Beacon Solutions Ltd., Sept 10, 2025), "Capturing the Supply Chain as HBOMs, SBOMs and more with SPDX 3.1". Presents SPDX 3.1+ as a relationship-driven graph language and ontology spanning Core, Software, Hardware, Supply Chain, Licensing, Services, Operations, AI, Dataset, Security, Cryptology, Safety, Threat Analysis, and Lite profiles. Introduces the Action methodology (Requirements -> Defined Process -> Action -> Evidence, illustrated with building a paper airplane), the Hardware profile (physical, virtual, and bulk hardware), and the Supply Chain profile (manufacture/assemble/reproduce/harvest, modification, destruction, custody, and transport actions, plus QUDT units for CO2 emissions). Includes a JSON-LD v3.0.1 multi-profile snippet (AMD A10-6700 APU PhysicalHardware) and an end-to-end graphite mining-to-battery-anode supply chain mapped to EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) and Digital Product Passport (DPP) requirements, plus uranium mining disposal metadata and master inventory SBOM/HBOM/AIBOM/VEX import-export.
